title_sq: Prane 21 Dhjetorit, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Ideal Per Investim Dhe Per Banim !!
description_sq: Ne zonen e 21 Dhjetorit pas Komisariatit nr.2 shitet apartament 1+1 ideal per investim dhe per banim. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e peste te nje pallati ekzistues pese katesh. Ka siperfaqe neto prej 57 m2. Organizohet ne korridor hyres, salloni i ndenjes bashke me ambientin e gatimit dhe dalje ne ballkon, dhoma e gjumit dhe tualeti me dritare. Orientimi eshte nga jug-lindja, qe e ben te kete drite natyrale dhe diell gjate gjithe dites. Apartamenti eshte i sapo investuar totalisht nga pronari duke filluar nga sistemi hidraulik, sistemi elektrik, dyer, dritaret dopioxham, etj. Zona ofron shume facilitete duke nisur nga lokacioni perfekt dhe per kete arsye eshte nje mundesi shume e mire si per te jetuar ashtu edhe per investim duke qene se qirate jane shume te larta ne ate zone. Zona ku ndodhet eshte mjaft e qete dhe me shume facilitete prane si kopshte, shkolla e shume sherbime te tjera. Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: Close to December 21, 1+1 Apartment for Sale, Ideal for Investment and Residence!!
description_en: In the area of ​​21 December, behind Police Station No. 2, a 1+1 apartment is for sale, ideal for investment and living. The apartment is located on the fifth floor of an existing five-story building. It has a net surface of 57 m2. It is organized in the entrance corridor, the living room together with the cooking area and exit to the balcony, the bedroom and the toilet with a window. The orientation is from the south-east, which makes it have natural light and sun throughout the day. The apartment has just been fully invested by the owner, starting with the plumbing system, electrical system, doors, double-glazed windows, etc. The area offers many facilities starting from the perfect location and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment since the rents are very high in that area. The area where it is located is quite quiet and has many facilities nearby such as kindergartens, schools and many other services. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
